This is Yun Kang with a community update for Greenville residents.
Taxes have increased significantly this year.
I'm sure you've noticed, and you likely want to know what your money is being spent on.
The city is moving forward with four major projects to improve the library, parks, the fire station, and roads.
Work on the fire station is currently underway, while the other projects will begin within a few months.
The mayoral election is approaching.
Your vote will influence which projects become priorities for our community's future.
The candidates will hold a debate in our studio this Wednesday.
We welcome your participation.
